name: code/add-feature
title: Add a feature
summary: Add a feature to existing code: read how the neighbours do it, change the fewest files, add a test, run it.
when: Use when the user wants a new feature added to code that already exists.
steps: Call glob_files with the project's own pattern, such as **/*.py, to see the files and pick the folder the feature belongs in.
Call grep_files with a word the neighbours use, such as the route or class name; when nothing matches, say so and read the folder's closest file.
Call read_files on two or three neighbour files to copy their naming, error handling and test style.
Make the smallest change that adds the feature and touches the fewest files, with apply_patch or replace_in_file.
Add one test next to the neighbour tests, with write_file or apply_patch, that fails if the feature is removed.
Call run_command with the project's test command, such as pytest, and read which test fails and why.
Call undo_changes and take a smaller step when the change breaks tests that passed before it.
Answer with the files changed, the test that proves the feature, and how the user calls it.
next: The final answer must list the files changed, the test that proves the feature, how to use it, and the test result.
